disposition: New Meshy multi-image-to-3D mesh rigged on the 15-bone quadruped skeleton beside the installed redesign model; flag-off candidate; installed creature_bramblebun_redesign_lod0.glb, species.json and every runtime path are unchanged.
request: Creatures lane judges: new model from bramblebun_redesign/reference (side/front/back): long upright ears with pink inner, a small antler, moss-and-flower mantle on the back only, tan-brown fur; earlier candidates dropped the ears, so the concept emphasises tall ears and any 3D result without them is rejected.

concept_task.prompt: Bramblebun, a stylised forest hare creature for a 3D action RPG, the same character as the reference images. MOST IMPORTANT FEATURE: two very tall, long, upright rabbit ears standing straight up from the top of the head, each ear as tall as the head and body combined above the shoulders, thick and broad leaf-shaped ears with solid volume (not paper thin), a soft light pink inner ear surface and tan-brown fur on the back of the ear, the two ears slightly apart in a clear V, clearly visible in every view. One pair of small short branching wooden antler twigs growing from the forehead just in front of the ears, much shorter than the ears. Tan-brown and warm grey-brown fur body with a cream chest ruff and cream muzzle, dark round eyes with a white catchlight, small pink-brown nose. A mantle of green moss, small leaves and a few tiny pale yellow and white flowers covering ONLY the upper back and shoulders like a cape; the face, ears, chest, legs and belly are fur with no moss. Chunky rounded stylised body with sturdy legs, fluffy round tail. Neutral four-legged standing stance on all four paws, legs clearly separated from each other and from the belly with visible gaps, head facing forward, full body including the full height of both ears in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, Palworld / Animal Crossing-style 3D game look, matte stylised clumped fur, readable, not photoreal. No red, no oxblood, no maroon. No accessories, no saddle, single creature only.
concept_task.inspected: 3 views (front/side/back): two tall upright ears with pink inner in every view, small branching antlers, moss/leaf/flower mantle on back and shoulders only, tan-brown fur with cream chest/muzzle, four-legged stance with leg gaps; no red.

generation_verdict: Both tall ears survive in the 3D mesh (upright, pink inner, ~40% of total height), small antler twigs in front of the ears, moss-and-flower mantle on the back and shoulders only, tan-brown and warm grey-brown fur with cream chest/muzzle, fluffy tail. Not a judge verdict.

concept_task.prompt: Bramblebun, a stylised forest hare creature for a 3D action RPG, the same character as the reference images (the reference drawings set the identity; the clean 3D renders set the face and render style). MOST IMPORTANT: a BODY-HEAVY, chunky, round, well-fed rabbit: a big barrel-shaped body and broad haunches that clearly dominate the silhouette, sturdy thick legs, a large rounded head. The two upright rabbit ears are thick and broad with solid volume but SHORTER than before: each ear is only about one quarter of the total standing height (about the height of the head), so the body and head make up three quarters of the height. Soft light pink inner ear surface. One pair of SMALL short branching wooden antler twigs growing from the forehead in front of the ears, much shorter than the ears. Coat: the WHOLE creature (body, back, flanks, belly sides, all four legs, the backs of the ears and the top of the head) is a mottled LEAF-GREEN and warm LOAM-BROWN fur coat, patches of mossy leaf green (#6f8a3a) blended with rich loam brown (#6b4f35), with small leaves tucked in the fur; no plain tan areas. DARK BROWN and deep PLUM thorn vines (#3f2a22 and #4a2a44) with small thorns wrap loosely around the shoulders, flanks and legs. A CREAM face mask and muzzle and a big fluffy CREAM chest ruff (#eee3c8); dark round eyes with a white catchlight, small brown nose. Fluffy round tail. Neutral four-legged standing stance on all four paws, legs clearly separated from each other and from the belly with visible gaps, head facing forward, full body including both ears in frame, plain flat light grey background, even studio lighting, Palworld / Animal Crossing-style 3D game look, matte stylised clumped fur, readable, not photoreal. No red, no oxblood, no maroon, no crimson thorns. No accessories, no saddle, single creature only.
